story.title: The Ant-Camel of the Cloud Peaks
story.signature_move: It vaults across the abyss on stilt legs and snaps its mandibles to pin the ibex against the cliff face.
story.hybrid_look: With a three-part segmented ant body, a camel-shaped head with ant eyes, and stilt-long legs ending in wide padded feet, its glossy red-brown armour blends with patches of fur as it paces in a rolling, swaying stride.

sentences.text: This impossible giant drinks your nightmares before breakfast.
